_classes.name: duplicate_provision gate drops parallel provisions from a different chapter/section
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='duplicate_provision' AND overlapped record (from reason 'overlaps <id>') has same matter_id and same agency AND dropped quote != kept quote (near-parallel text, not identical); dropped records carry no citation, so this over-counts true near-duplicates

_classes.name: condition_of_other_record drops a separate prohibition in another section
_classes.rule: needs_judgment: dropped records carry no citation to compare with the target record

_classes.name: sunset extension stored with agency Unspecified when the extended provision names its holder
entitlement stored as a duty (known class, recurrence count)
_classes.rule: provision_kind!='power' AND quote ~ /\b(employees?|members?|officers?)\b[^.]{0,120}\bshall (be paid|receive|continue to receive)\b/i

_classes.name: State-convened labor-management committee stored as its own agency
_classes.rule: agency ~ /labor-management/i (committee stored as agency instead of OER parent + agency_unit)

_classes.name: signage installation-and-maintenance duty not recurrence ongoing
_classes.rule: deliverable_type=='signage or installation' AND quote ~ /installation and maintenance/i AND recurrence!='ongoing'

_classes.name: narrowing amendment of an existing power stored as an extends_existing power
_classes.rule: extends_existing AND quote ~ /shall have the power to/i AND quote ~ /\bparagraph\b/ (weak; true class needs the bracket/brace diff)

_classes.name: joint actor stored for one body (known class): 'upon audit and warrant of the comptroller ... and by the appropriate fiscal officer'
_classes.rule: needs_judgment: stored quotes omit the second actor

2021-S7232-01.quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of this section, the director of the budget may reduce the salary of any such position which is or becomes vacant.

2021-S7232-04.quote: any increase in compensation may be withheld in whole or in part from any employee to whom the provisions of this section are applicable when, in the opinion of the director of the budget and the director of employee relations, such increase is not warranted or is not appropriate for any reason.

2021-S7171-01.quote: the probation service may adjust a proceeding where the court has referred a case to the probation service in accordance with section 320.6 of this article in conjunction with or subsequent to the issuance of an order pursuant to subdivision one of section 345.1

2021-S7171-02.quote: the probation service shall adjust the matter unless good cause is shown and is documented in its records.

2021-S7171-03.quote: nor shall the detention of a child adjudicated solely for an act that would constitute a violation as defined in subdivision three of section 10.00 of the penal law, be directed

2021-S7171-04.quote: there shall be a rebuttable presumption that the court shall adjourn the case in contemplation of dismissal pursuant to this section, refer the case to the probation service for adjustment services pursuant to section 320.6 of this article or dismiss the case pursuant to subdivision two of section 352.1 of this article.

2021-S7171-05.quote: there shall be a rebuttable presumption that the court shall refer the case to the probation service for adjustment services in accordance with this subdivision, dismiss the case pursuant to subdivision two of section 352.1 of this article or adjourn the case in contemplation of dismissal pursuant to section 315.3 of this article.

2021-S7171-06.quote: there shall be a rebuttable presumption that the court shall refer the case to the probation service for adjustment services in accordance with section 320.6 of this article, dismiss the case pursuant to subdivision two of section 352.1 of this article or adjourn the case in contemplation of dismissal pursuant to section 315.3 of this article.

2021-S7171-09.quote: The court shall not order detention, probation or placement of a youth solely adjudicated under this subdivision.

2021-S7171-10.quote: the court may modify the conditions of the conditional discharge but may not order any other disposition under section 352.2 of this article

2021-S7171-11.quote: the records shall be sealed automatically at the expiration, as applicable, of a successful period of an adjustment, adjournment in contemplation of dismissal or conditional discharge.

2021-S7171-12.quote: nor shall a principal under the age specified who is charged solely with a violation as defined in subdivision three of section 10.00 of the penal law be subject to detention

2021-S7171-08.quote: the court shall have the power to enter an order of disposition in accordance with paragraph (a) of subdivision one of this section.

2021-S6362-01.quote: No court shall issue a judgment in any proceeding authorizing a warrant of eviction against a respondent who has defaulted, or authorize the enforcement of an eviction pursuant to a default judgment, prior to August 31, 2021, without first holding a hearing

2021-S6362-02.quote: if the tenant provides a hardship declaration to the petitioner, the court, or an agent of the petitioner or the court, the eviction proceeding shall be stayed until at least August 31, 2021.

2021-S6362-05.quote: if the mortgagor provides a hardship declaration to the foreclosing party, the court, or an agent of the foreclosing party or the court, the proceeding shall be stayed until at least August 31, 2021.

2021-S6362-06.quote: if the mortgagor provides a hardship declaration to the foreclosing party, the court, or an agent of the foreclosing party or the court, prior to the execution of the judgment, the execution shall be stayed until at least August 31, 2021.

2021-S6362-07.quote: if the tenant provides a hardship declaration to the petitioner or plaintiff, the court, or an agent of the petitioner or plaintiff or the court, the eviction proceeding shall be stayed until at least August 31, 2021.

2021-S6362-08.quote: if the tenant provides a hardship declaration to the petitioner or plaintiff, the court, or an agent of the petitioner or plaintiff or the court, prior to the execution of the warrant or judgment, the execution shall be stayed until at least August 31, 2021.

2021-S6362-09.quote: If the petitioner or plaintiff fails to establish that the tenant persistently and unreasonably engaged in such behavior and the tenant provides or has provided a hardship declaration to the petitioner, petitioner's or plaintiff's agent or the court, the court shall stay or continue to stay any further proceedings until at least August 31, 2021.

2021-S5357-01.quote: The governor may extend or modify any directive, by executive order, that has been issued and remains in effect on the effective date of this act for additional 30 day increments in a manner provided for in this section

2021-S5357-02.quote: No later than 5 days prior to the extension or modification of such a directive, the governor shall notify including via electronic means the relevant committee chairs in the assembly and senate and the speaker of the assembly and temporary president of the senate

2021-S5357-03.quote: he or she shall provide such certification required by the commissioner of health as provided in subdivision 1 of this section as soon as possible, but in any event, prior to the issuance of an extension or modification of such a directive.

2021-S5357-04.quote: The governor shall provide an opportunity to comment on any such directive by the relevant committee chairs, which comments may be received after the issuance of the directive and shall not affect the validity thereof.

2021-S5357-05.quote: No later than 5 days prior to the extension or modification of a directive only explicitly affecting specific municipalities, the governor shall notify including via electronic means the relevant executive leaders of such municipalities and such municipal legislature

2021-S5357-07.quote: The governor shall provide an opportunity to comment on any such directive by such executive leaders and legislatures, which comments may be received after the issuance of the directive and shall not affect the validity thereof.

2021-S5357-09.quote: No directive shall be extended or modified to the extent that such directive prohibits the adoption by any municipality of this state a local executive order within such municipality's existing power except where such an order conflicts with any executive order issued by the state.

2021-S5357-11.quote: The legislature may terminate by concurrent resolution executive orders issued under this section at any time.

2021-S5357-12.quote: Directives shall be effective from the time and in the manner prescribed in such orders and shall be published as soon as practicable in the state bulletin and as provided in this section.
2021-S5357-12.note: actor_raw 'directives' is the passive subject; agency Governor is right

2021-S5357-13.quote: Such certification shall include a detailed explanation of how such directive will address the spread and/or reduction of the COVID-19 virus, facilitate vaccine distribution or administration, or require the use of face coverings

2021-S5357-14.quote: Within 15 days of the effective date of this section all current suspensions and directives authorized pursuant to executive orders 202 and 205 of 2020 and this act shall be posted on the website for the office of the governor in a searchable format
2021-S5357-14.note: deadline 2021-03-22 = 15 days after 2021-03-07; actor_raw is the website (passive) but agency right

2021-S5357-15.quote: Such website shall be updated upon the issuance of every suspension or directive pursuant to this act.

2021-S5357-16.quote: Every thirty days, such website shall also be updated with responses to written comments or information requests from relevant committee chairs or municipal government entities received pursuant to the provisions of this act.

2021-S5357-17.quote: The legislature may terminate at any time a state disaster emergency issued under this section by concurrent resolution.

missed.quote: If the governor certifies that the extension or modification of such a directive is necessary to address any exigent circumstances that address an imminent threat to the public health or safety, he or she shall provide such certification required by the commissioner of health as provided in subdivision 1 of this section, as soon as possible
